hook: Your phone clock in Russia has to handle 11 time zones.
title: Russia Has 11 Time Zones in One Country
description:
Russia spans 11 time zones, more than any other country. When it is morning in one end, it can already be night at the other. India has just one, which makes this even stranger to picture.

#Shorts #Russia #TimeZones
comment_prompt: Could you handle it? Yes or no
